name: Unoki
tagline: Shibuya in 29 minutes and Shinagawa in 29 minutes. Served by 1 line. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥70,000 to ¥80,000.
summary: The station is in Ota City, served by Tokyu Tamagawa Line. Journey times to the main business districts are 48 minutes to Otemachi, 39 minutes to Shinjuku, 29 minutes to Shibuya and 29 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥70,000 to ¥80,000. The station stands 5.7 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 10.6 m. The land around the station has gentle slopes.

terrain.note: The station sits lower than the ground around it, at 5.7 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 4.3 m to 14.9 m, a difference of 10.6 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls inside the projected inundation area, to a projected depth of 0.5 to 3 m. Of the nine points within 400 m of the station, 6 fall inside the area, and the deepest projection among them is 3 to 5 m. The projected depth differs block by block within the same station area, so check the ward hazard map for the specific address. Inland flooding from overwhelmed drains has no nationwide map; each ward publishes its own, and that is worth reading as well.

medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 11 clinics and 8 pharmacies. The nearest facility recorded as a hospital is 池田動物病院, about 1118 m from the station. The next nearest is 田園調布中央病院, about 1573 m away. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 1 line serve the station: Tokyu Tamagawa Line.
congestion: Tokyu Tamagawa Line runs at 112% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch is 矢口渡→蒲田, which this station is not on. At 100%, the ministry's scale describes every passenger either seated or able to hold a strap or pillar. The figures describe each line's busiest stretch, so the stretch you ride may be easier.

rentRange.note: One room ¥70,000 to ¥80,000, 1K ¥80,000 to ¥90,000, 1LDK ¥130,000 to ¥140,000 and 2LDK ¥200,000 to ¥210,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.

leads.terrain: There are gentle slopes around the station, and which block you live on changes how much effort getting about takes.
leads.groceries: There are 5 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 4 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: The number of points that fall inside the projected inundation area is about average for a station in the 23 wards.
leads.stationNote: Only the Tokyu Tamagawa Line serves this station, so when it stops you walk to another station.
